# VEGHA & ASSOCIATES

> Partner-led Chartered Accountancy firm in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Established 21 May 2001.

Contact: +91 94945 02727 | admin@veghaandassociates.com
Address: 1-8-678/B/1, Padma Colony, Nallakunta, Hyderabad, Telangana 500044
Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 am to 6:00 pm

## Services
- Assurance & Audit: Independent assurance that goes past the statutory minimum, strengthening controls, sharpening reporting and building stakeholder confidence.
- Direct Taxation: Corporate and personal tax planning, compliance, assessments and litigation support, managed so obligations are met efficiently and defensibly.
- Indirect Taxation (GST): GST registration, returns, audits, input credit reviews and departmental representation under a regime that changes constantly.
- Corporate & Regulatory Services: Incorporation, ROC and secretarial compliance, FEMA and RBI matters, restructuring and governance advisory.
- Accounting & Business Support Services: Bookkeeping, payroll, MIS, virtual CFO and financial reporting, dependable numbers that management can actually decide on.
- Risk Advisory & Internal Controls: Enterprise risk frameworks, SOP development, process improvement and fraud risk assessment for organisations that are scaling.
- Business Advisory: Strategy, valuation support, restructuring, profitability analysis and working capital advice grounded in your actual numbers.
- International Business Services: Cross-border structuring, FEMA compliance, UAE corporate tax and global compliance coordination for businesses operating across jurisdictions.
- Start-Up & MSME Advisory: End-to-end support from entity selection and incorporation through investor readiness and funding documentation.

## Industries
- Real Estate & Construction
- Manufacturing
- Pharmaceuticals & Life Sciences
- Mining & Natural Resources
- Banking & Financial Services
